flows.name: New Account Onboarding
flows.summary: Create a new account — generate key, enable notifications, set handle

steps.title: Welcome
steps.description: Tuyo splash screen with Visa card hero image. Tagline: 'Spend. Earn. Trade. Bank.' Three options: green 'Get started' button, 'Already have a Tuyo account?' button, and 'I have a referral code' link. Terms of service link at bottom.

steps.title: Create key — hold to generate
steps.description: 'Let's create your key' with decorative geometric key illustration. Green hand icon at bottom with 'HOLD TO CREATE' instruction. User must press and hold to generate their cryptographic key.
steps.changes: Navigation pushed key creation screen.

steps.title: Create key — ready
steps.description: 'Let's create your key' — key shape has transformed into a lock/card outline with keyhole icon in center. 'TAP INSIDE WHEN YOU FEEL READY' instruction at bottom. Key generation complete.
steps.changes: Key illustration animated into completed state. Instruction changed from hold to tap.

steps.title: Enable notifications
steps.description: Bell icon with green dot. 'Enable notifications — Stay updated about transactions and important updates.' Two options: green 'Enable now' button, 'Skip for now' button.
steps.changes: Navigation pushed notifications opt-in screen.

steps.title: Choose handle
steps.action: Tap Enable now / Skip for now
steps.description: Profile icon with green ring. 'Set up your profile — Choose your handle.' Two options: green 'Set handle' button, 'Skip for now' button.
steps.changes: Navigation pushed handle setup screen.

steps.title: Home screen
steps.action: Tap Set handle / Skip for now
steps.description: Main dashboard showing Total balance $0.00. Onboarding complete — user lands on home screen.
steps.changes: Onboarding flow dismissed. Home screen with full tab bar.

flows.name: Recover Account
flows.summary: Recover existing account by importing mnemonic

steps.title: Welcome
steps.description: Tuyo splash screen with Visa card hero. 'Get started', 'Already have a Tuyo account?', and 'I have a referral code' options.

steps.title: Recover account
steps.action: Tap Already have a Tuyo account?
steps.description: Recover account screen with animated lock/keyhole illustration. 'Import mnemonic manually' button. 'Continue without recovering your account' link at bottom. Back chevron top-left.
steps.changes: Navigation pushed recover account screen.

steps.title: Home screen

steps.title: Token search
steps.description: Token search screen with search bar at top. Watchlist section showing USDC ($1.00), Ethereum ($2,062.82, +3.87%), EURC ($1.15), Bitcoin ($67,626.00, +1.59%). Below, 'Most Relevant' section with more tokens including BNB, Sky Dollar, Chain Link, Ethena USDe, USD1. Each row has icon, name, ticker, sparkline chart, price, and % change.

steps.title: Token detail (MemeCore)
steps.description: Bottom sheet showing MemeCore (M) at $2.31, +1.82% (+$0.04) Today. Four action buttons: Buy (green +), Sell (grey -), Receive (download arrow), Send (arrow). Price chart with timeframe toggles (24H, 7D, 30D, 1Y, ALL). 'Your balance' section showing VALUE $0.00, AMOUNT 0 M.
steps.changes: Bottom sheet slid up with token detail. Heart/favorite icon top-right.

steps.title: Home screen

steps.title: Choose the source

flows.name: Receive Crypto

steps.title: Home screen
steps.description: Main dashboard showing Total balance $0.00, quick action buttons (Add money, Send, Convert), yield promo card, and bottom tab bar.

steps.title: Choose the source
steps.description: Bottom sheet presenting three funding sources: Bank (INSTANT), Wallet (INSTANT), Coinbase.
steps.changes: Bottom sheet slid up over home screen.

steps.description: 'One address for all your crypto.' QR code with avatar overlay. Supported networks listed: Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, BNB, Ethereum. Wallet address shown at bottom (0x93d5391c3...2aadf6ce569) with copy button.

flows.name: Send Money
flows.summary: Send via Tuyo username, wallet address, or bank account

steps.title: Home screen (with balance)
steps.description: Home dashboard with $1.00 Total balance. EARN section ($0.00) and CASH section ($1.00 USDC). Recent transactions showing two Receive USDC entries. Bottom tab bar.

steps.title: Add Recipient
steps.description: Send screen with 'Add Recipient' header. Three options: Find on Tuyo (BEST badge) — send instantly with @Tuyoname, Wallet Address — wallet address for crypto transfers, Bank Account — account details for bank transfers.
steps.changes: Navigation pushed Send screen with recipient type selection.

steps.title: Send to Wallet Address
steps.description: Enter Wallet Address screen with 'To:' input field pre-filled with '0x' placeholder. '0x' badge with prompt 'Send crypto to any 0x address'.
steps.changes: Bottom sheet showing wallet address input.

steps.title: Send to Bank Account
steps.description: Bank Account option triggers identity verification prompt: 'Takes 2 min'. Lists benefits: Get a USD bank account number, Request your Tuyo Card, Your data stays private & secure. Green 'Verify identity' button and 'Not now' option.
steps.changes: Bottom sheet with identity verification prompt overlaying the Send screen.

flows.notes: Bank account transfers require identity verification. Wallet address and Tuyo username transfers do not.

steps.changes: Navigation pushed Send screen.

steps.title: Tuyo user found
